description: Astragentic project-local safety hooks for Codex.

hooks.command: d="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; s="$d/scripts/hook-git-guard.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || s="$d/harness/scripts/hook-git-guard.py"; if [ -f "$s" ]; then exec python3 "$s"; else cat >/dev/null; echo "hook-git-guard: NOT FOUND under $d — the git guard is not running" >&2; echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) hook-git-guard MISSING under $d" >> /tmp/harness-hook-events.log; fi

d="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; s="$d/scripts/hook-contract-reload.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || s="$d/harness/scripts/hook-contract-reload.py"; if [ -f "$s" ]; then exec python3 "$s"; else cat >/dev/null; echo "hook-contract-reload: NOT FOUND under $d — role contracts are not re-armed after compaction" >&2; echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) hook-contract-reload MISSING under $d" >> /tmp/harness-hook-events.log; fi

d="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; s="$d/scripts/hook-tracker-status.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || s="$d/harness/scripts/hook-tracker-status.py"; if [ -f "$s" ]; then exec python3 "$s"; else cat >/dev/null; echo "hook-tracker-status: NOT FOUND under $d — tracker counts are not injected at session start" >&2; echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) hook-tracker-status MISSING under $d" >> /tmp/harness-hook-events.log; fi
